name: Korea Electric Terminal Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Electric Terminal Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells parts for automotive and electronics in South Korea and internationally. It provides automotive connectors, including wire to wire connector, PCB, joint, automotive terminal, lightning connector, sub part, and rework jig; e-mobility systems, such as high voltage fuse and connector, BDU, ICB, and charge inlet; data connectivity systems, comprising FAKRA connector, LVDS, and bard to board connector; fuses and BFT. Further, it offers airbag sensor and connector, cable assemblies, and electronic connectors. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Incheon, South Korea.
